correspondences.notes: Echoes are separate files told apart by the echo entity; one sidecar per echo is rebuilt from metadata.

brainlife.desc: Multi-echo BOLD fMRI run: one 4D NIfTI per echo (2 to 6); echo times kept as an EchoTime array in metadata. Experimental.
brainlife.name: neuro/func/multiecho

original.desc: (experimental datatype) Functional bold image using multi-echo
original.readme:
Metadata must contain EchoTime in Array for each bold image. This array will be split into individual .json by bl2bids to create BIDS compliant file structure. 

```
"EchoTime": [ 1.0, 1.2, 1.3 ]
```

tier_conditions: Tier 3 if metadata keeps acquisition dates or device serials

sources: catalog/apps/<app_id>.json (manifests of the Apps in usage)

intended_use: Export to BIDS (bl2bids splits EchoTime into per-echo sidecars) for multi-echo pipelines.
